basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old fashion enthusiast hailing from Vancouver, Canada. I recently discovered the world of athleisure and have been obsessed with finding the perfect pair of leggings ever since. I work as a junior marketing coordinator for a local startup, which gives me a decent work-life balance. I enjoy hiking and exploring the beautiful outdoors of British Columbia on weekends. My evenings are usually spent browsing Reddit, especially after dinner around 8 PM local time. I'm currently single and enjoy connecting with people online to share tips and experiences.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor’s degree in business administration with a focus on marketing. My interest in technology and lifestyle products has led me to self-educate about the latest trends in athleisure. Much of my knowledge comes from online forums, fashion blogs, and personal experience with different brands.
